The '''''Galactic Breeze''''' was a cruise [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. A number of [[XLT-014 labor droid]]s were used aboard the ship and when one of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] programmed the ship's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] with an incorrect destination, the ship was brought off-course and captured by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]].
